title.en: An Act Granting to "Imus Electric Company, Inc.," a Franchise to Install, Operate, and Maintain An Electric Light, Heat and Power Plant in the Municipality of Bacoor, Province of Cavite, Philippine Islands.

text.en:
Subject to the rules and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and
thirty-six, there is hereby granted to "Imus Electric Company, Inc.," for a period of fifty years from the
approval of this Act, the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and operate an electric light, heat
and power system for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and power, for sale within
the limits of the municipality of Bacoor, Province of Cavite, Philippine Islands.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 4, 1930.
